name: top10/2023
sql: WITH parties AS (SELECT party_key,sum(award_amount_sum)/1000000000 AS v FROM fact_supplier_daily WHERE currency_key='VND' AND recipient_allocation_state='single_recipient' AND eligible_amount_count>0 AND party_key IN (SELECT party_key FROM dim_party WHERE party_kind<>'UNKNOWN') AND year(report_date)=2023 GROUP BY 1), top_people AS (SELECT * FROM parties ORDER BY v DESC,party_key LIMIT 10) SELECT (SELECT sum(v) FROM top_people)/(SELECT sum(v) FROM parties)
